learningGoals: Identify different coins and currency notes. 💵
Understand the basic concept of buying and selling items. 🛒
Practice simple addition and subtraction using money in real-life contexts. ➕
Learn the value of money and making wise choices. 🧠
teachingTips: Show them real coins and notes and explain their different values. 💵
Take them to a local shop and let them hand the money to the shopkeeper for a small item. 🏪
Play pretend games where one of you is the shopkeeper and the other is the customer. 🎭
Discuss the prices of their favorite snacks to help them understand how much things cost. 🍫

funActivities.title: Pretend Shop 🧸
funActivities.description: Put price tags on some toys at home. Give your child fake money and let them buy toys from you.

funActivities.title: Coin Sorting 🪙
funActivities.description: Mix up some clean 1, 2, 5, and 10 Rupee coins and ask them to sort them into different bowls.

funActivities.title: Piggy Bank Counting 🐷
funActivities.description: Open up a piggy bank together and count the total amount by adding the small coins first.
